Dear Vlugg Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Intern position at Vlugg. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content creation, and web analytics, I am excited about the opportunity to support your mission of connecting neighbors with trusted local professionals.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and track performance using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. I have also built and maintained WordPress sites, including my own project mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and technical audits to improve search visibility. I am comfortable with social media content creation and community engagement, and I am eager to apply these skills to help grow Vlugg's online presence.

I am particularly drawn to Vlugg's focus on local community and user-friendly technology. I am proactive, detail-oriented, and quick to learn new tools. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available for remote part-time work.

I would love to discuss how I can contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Vlugg Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketing Intern position at Vlugg. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in SEO, content creation, and web analytics, I am eager to contribute to your mission of making home services accessible and reliable through local connections.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in planning and executing digital marketing activities. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted blog content that drives organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring a seamless user experience. My daily work involves tracking performance with tools like Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, and using those insights to optimize campaigns and improve reach.

Beyond my professional experience, I have developed my own project, mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site and implemented advanced SEO and GEO techniques, including structured data and entity optimization. This project has honed my ability to work independently and think creatively about improving visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines.

I am particularly drawn to Vlugg because of its focus on community trust and user-friendly technology. I am proactive, detail-oriented, and quick to learn, and I am comfortable with social media content creation and community engagement. I am currently pursuing further studies in Applied Computer Science, which complements my practical marketing skills.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring my enthusiasm and skills to Vlugg's marketing team. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
